evidence.summary: Tested during initial exploration in Queries #1–#15; setting recent_strikes to 5 heavily penalized baseline scores down toward 0.0560.
Evaluated during initial risk parameter tests in Queries #1–#15; setting report_ratio to 1 acts as a primary penalty driver.
Isolated in Query #11 where setting account_age_days to max (75) pushed the base score threshold upward toward approval.
Varying mentions between 2.85 (Query #24) and 6 (Query #29) produced zero score shift.
Increasing reach from 0 in Query #29 to 100 in Query #30 caused the sharp red dip on the graph (-0.4737 penalty, dropping from 0.6729 to 0.1992).
Switching surface from A in Query #24 to B in Query #34 moved the baseline score up to 0.7010 under identical parameters.
Lowering post_length from 100 in Query #34 to 75 in Query #35 caused the score drop visible at Query #35 (from 0.7010 to 0.6163).
Tested during the flat plateau region between Queries #36 and #44; changing linked_accounts yielded zero variance in score output.
Lowering reputation from 900 to 300 in Query #45 created the steep upward jump visible on the graph, driving the score from ~0.70 to 0.9478 (APPROVE).
